dependencyVulnerabilityExceptions.reason: Next.js 14.2.15 has upstream advisories for Server Actions, RSC DoS, and Image Optimization. In the current Phase 01/02 workspace, apps/web runs only static smoke routes without Server Actions or production public serving. Tracked for framework upgrade in later phases.

node-tar traversal and memory consumption advisories in build-time CLI tooling dependencies (Expo CLI / React Native CLI). Used exclusively during local bundle compilation, not exposed in production web/backend runtime.
xmldom injection/ReDoS advisories in build-time XML parsing used by Expo CLI config plugins during Android manifest prebuild. Not bundled into client or server runtimes.
PostCSS source map disclosure advisories in build-time bundler tooling used during Next.js build. Not executed in production server environment.
image-size infinite loop advisories in Expo CLI local asset parsing. Operates only on trusted project assets during build time.
node-forge RSA signature parsing advisory in Metro/Expo local development server certificate generation. Never used in production auth or cryptography.
braces ReDoS advisory in build-time glob tooling. Local development and build environments only.
tinypool prototype pollution in Vitest threadpool runner. Vitest runs only in trusted local/CI developer test executions.
